headword: {限定免許|げんていめんきょ}

definitions.explanation: A driver's license with specific restrictions, most commonly the AT限定 (automatic transmission only) license in Japan, which does not permit the holder to drive manual transmission vehicles.

examples.japanese: AT{限定免許|げんていめんきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
{限定免許|げんていめんきょ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦マニュアル→マニュアル：26993_manyuaru⟧⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}できない→運転する：20318_untensuru⟧。
examples.english: With a restricted license, you can't drive a manual transmission car.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧AT{限定免許|げんていめんきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大半|たいはん}→大半：00400_taihan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦マニュアル→マニュアル：26993_manyuaru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: These days, the majority of people get an automatic-only license, and fewer people get a manual one.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧ (limitation; restriction) and ⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧ (license). In Japan, the most common type is the AT⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧ (automatic-only) driver's license. The ⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧ condition is noted on the license itself, and driving a vehicle outside the restriction is a traffic violation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- AT{限定免許|げんていめんきょ}: automatic transmission-only license
- {限定免許|げんていめんきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}する→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧: to obtain a restricted license
- ⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}→解除：05762_kaijo⟧: restriction removal (upgrading to a full license)
- {限定免許|げんていめんきょ}⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧: license restriction violation

USAGE:
As of recent years, over 60% of new license holders in Japan choose the AT⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧ option. The ⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}→解除：05762_kaijo⟧ process requires additional training at a driving school to upgrade to a full {普通免許|ふつうめんきょ}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {普通免許|ふつうめんきょ}: regular (unrestricted) driver's license
- {仮免許|かりめんきょ}: provisional/learner's license
- {国際免許|こくさいめんきょ}: international driver's license
